focus: Constraint preservation under repeated recursive context compaction with evolving synthetic policies
primary_estimand_proposal: Episode-averaged unsafe raw approval frequency on reference-reject cases after at least 2 compactions: recursive_summary minus pinned_ledger.
guard_contrast: Rule guard uses independently reconstructed authorised-event ledger; derived from exactly the same pinned-ledger GPT response. No extra model call or scoring oracle used.
pairing: Fixed oracle trajectory, identical policy and current request across conditions, no model-feedback into environment
information_privilege_caveat: Full history and pinned ledger have authoritative policy information that short-window baselines may not; do not assert equal-context model superiority.
inference: Descriptive only in development and pilot. Confirmatory method, sample and power must be preregistered at episode level.
